Aquapolis

Released January 15, 2003 · 182 cards

Aquapolis is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the E-Card series, released in English on January 15, 2003. Its main set has 147 cards, plus 35 secret rares numbered beyond the set (182 in total). It includes 152 Pokémon, 24 Trainer and 6 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

32 illustrators worked on Aquapolis. Most cards: Hajime Kusajima (13), Kagemaru Himeno (12), Atsuko Nishida (11), Naoyo Kimura (11), Kyoko Umemoto (9), Mitsuhiro Arita (9), Shin-ichi Yoshida (9), Yukiko Baba (9).
